analysis.suits: Four cosmetic suits; settlement depends only on ranks.
analysis.completeRound: One paid start, at least one guess, optional cashout after the first success, automatic settlement after the second guess. No additional paid continuations.
analysis.adaptivePolicies: Backward induction compares cashout and every legal higher/lower choice at every reachable first-success rank. Summing conditional minima and maxima covers every history-dependent stopping policy.
analysis.integerBounds: For every positive integer stake s and every legal complete-round strategy: 0.99 - 1/s < RTP <= 0.99. Listed bounds are exact integer-settlement extrema, not sampling estimates.
